_comment: What is released, as opposed to what is merged.
main carries content; a tag carries a signature (docs/DECISIONS.md
D-0067). Between releases this repository can hold changes no site has
been offered, because a site only ever fetches a tag and only a person
with the offline key can make one.
So this file exists to stop main lying by omission. It names the last
signed tag, when it was made, and the manifest it covers. README.md
reads from it, the release gate checks the pushed tag against it, and
manifest_sha256 is the sha256 of manifest.json's bytes at that tag --
the file the signature was made over, not a hash of the files it lists.
